name: unity
description: Open the current Unity project and run Editor actions through the official CLI, with Pipeline checks only on demand.

interface.shortDescription: Open Unity and check Pipeline only on demand
interface.longDescription: Recognize the current Unity project, open or reuse its Editor at session startup, and use the official Unity CLI for Editor actions. Calls wait for Pipeline readiness, compilation and import completion before dispatching once. Tracks compilation/test completion and optional long-running job results without replaying commands. Includes bounded diagnostics and explicit connection recovery.
defaultPrompt: Use $unity:editor to inspect the current Unity scene.
